payload.text: RESUME (vc, localfold for hv's compact cycle, 2026-10-14): after the compact, /in-session and the pickup, then HOLD on hold 3 until hv gives the restart. THE FOCUS (hv, 2026-10-14): Intent and devbin from Homebrew on Linux and macOS with no source checkout, Linux proven first on kovacs (Ubuntu 26.04.1 on aarch64, uutils coreutils, mawk, 2 CPUs, 3.3 GB plus a 3.8 GB swap file). RECORDS: ST0081 is the Homebrew thread and ST0082 the WSL thread that depends on it (7d1d2b8d4); issue 0595, `bin/int linux doctor` exiting 127 with no output on a host without Rust (found by kovacs-sysadm in ORDER 2, reproduced on rhadamanth with rustc off PATH), is filed at 65d5db612 and is cc's. KOVACS: ORDER 1 is complete. kovacs-sysadm ran the apt half, and hv ran ~/prov/provision-rest.sh (10:11Z to 10:12Z by kovacs's clock), which gave bats 1.12.0 (shadowing apt's 1.13.0), shellcheck 0.11.0, rustc and cargo 1.99.0 with the aarch64 musl target, and Homebrew 7.0.9, kept off PATH, which accepted aarch64 Linux. kovacs-sysadm's session still refuses clone-then-execute orders: devbin's ORDER D1 was refused, though ORDER 2 passed, so D1 waits for hv to run `! bash ~/work/devbin-vc/d1.sh` there or to add a rule, and Intent's ORDER 3 may meet the same refusal. Nobody routes any of it around that session. ORDER 2 left Intent cloned at b38bc26bc in ~/work/Intent. Orders source $HOME/.cargo/env themselves. hv's zshrc puts ~/.cargo/bin on PATH in interactive shells, so 0595's red arm sets PATH explicitly. THE QUEUE after hv: devbin's suite (devbin-vc), Intent's build --jobs 1 with TMPDIR on disk, AT-05.1 (red at 8c51de484 from cc's test-half patch, sha256 300357635a3e..., with `cargo build -p intentd` at the base first; green at the pin), Intent's user drive, devbin's check all with Intent's package, Intent's shell suite, then the brew rehearsal. LANES: the AT-05.1 test-half patch is banked at refs/bank/cc/0081/at051-test-half (blob 20712d9d2, patch-id 3f31071f, read back by vc); WP-06's shape is agreed and in its record; cc fixes 0595 with a shim-PATH bats arm after the restart, then WP-06; dc sizes M2 (provisionally S, a post-conversion facade opening the pre-conversion Project, not yet driven) and builds 0593, 0592, 0591 and 0594 stacked in one worktree, with landing and judging held for hv's 3.2.4 scope ruling. OPEN WITH hv: the kovacs permissions; D55 (devbin's proposal (a), vc's lean the same; cc found that publish refuses any release that already carries assets, so (a) needs publish to ask for its own by name, which WP-06 now does); 3.2.4's scope; a devbin brew thread, first-hand to devbin-vc; and vc's calls under the pen, any of which hv may reverse (provisioning now, no resize, a discovery run then a confirming run on the final tree, Intent's shell suite once on kovacs). STILL LIVE: AC-01.1 and AC-01.2 are satisfied only by the dispatch run after hv's push. vc OWES: the kovacs orders and their judgement, 0595's judgement, the pre-push heavy run and build all, and the globalfold. vc's message stamps of 10:00Z, 10:03Z, 10:06Z (the GO) and 10:08Z were not read from a clock, and each recipient was told they are unverifiable.
